chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Qāsim, from Ḥanān ibn al-Sarrāj, from Dāwūd ibn Sulaymān al-Kisāʾī, from Abū al-Ṭufayl, who said:

I attended the funeral of Abū Bakr on the day he died, and I attended ʿUmar when allegiance was pledged to him, while ʿAlī عليه السلام was seated to one side. Then a Jewish youth came forward, handsome of face, radiant, wearing fine clothes, and he was from the descendants of Hārūn. He stood at the head of ʿUmar and said: “O Commander of the Faithful, are you the most knowledgeable of this community regarding their Book and the matter of their Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?” He said: ʿUmar lowered his head, so he said: “It is you whom I mean,” and he repeated the statement to him. Then ʿUmar said to him: “Why is that?” He said: “I have come to you seeking certainty for myself, while doubting in my religion.” So he said: “Take this young man.” He said: “And who is this young man?” He said: “This is ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, the cousin of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and this is the father of al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn, the two sons of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and this is the husband of Fāṭimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.”

Then the Jew turned toward ʿAlī عليه السلام and said: “Are you as such?” He said: “Yes.” He said: “I wish to ask you about three, and three, and one.” He said: the Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام smiled slightly and said: “O Hārūnī, what prevented you from saying seven?” He said: “I will ask you about three; if you answer me, I will ask about what comes after them, and if you do not know them, I will know that there is no knowledgeable one among you.” ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “Then I ask you by the God whom you worship: if I answer you regarding all that you want, you must surely leave your religion and enter into my religion.” He said: “I came only for that.” He said: “Then ask.” He said: “Inform me about the first drop of blood that dripped upon the face of the earth—which drop was it? And the first spring that gushed forth upon the face of the earth—which spring was it? And the first thing that shook upon the face of the earth—which thing was it?”

Then the Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام answered him. Then he said to him: “Inform me about the other three. Inform me about Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله: how many just Imams are there for him, in which Garden will he be, and who will dwell with him in his Garden?” So he said: “O Hārūnī, for Muḥammad there are twelve just Imams. The abandonment of those who abandon them does not harm them, nor are they made desolate by the opposition of those who oppose them. In religion they are more firmly rooted than the lofty mountains in the earth. The dwelling of Muḥammad in his Garden shall be with those twelve just Imams.”

He said: “You have spoken the truth. By Allah, besides Whom there is no god, I indeed find this in the books of my father Hārūn; he wrote it with his own hand, and Mūsā my uncle عليه السلام dictated it.” He said: “So inform me about the one. Inform me about the successor of Muḥammad: how long will he live after him, and will he die or be killed?” He said: “O Hārūnī, he will live after him for thirty years, neither increasing by one day nor decreasing by one day. Then he will be struck a blow here”—meaning upon his head—“and this will be dyed from this.”

He said: Then the Hārūnī cried out and cut off his kustīj, while saying: “I testify that there is no god except Allah alone, having no partner, and I testify that Muḥammad is His servant and His Messenger, and that you are his successor. It is fitting that you excel and not be excelled, and that you be magnified and not deemed weak.” He said: Then ʿAlī عليه السلام took him to his منزل and taught him the landmarks of the religion.

key_terms.إِمَامٍ عَدْلٍ: a just Imam vested with rightful religious authority
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ الْعَدْلَ: the just Imam characterized by truth and rightful guidance
key_terms.الْهَارُونِيُّ: the descendant of Hārūn who questions the Imam
key_terms.جَنَّتِهِ: his Garden, referring to the Prophet’s abode in paradise
key_terms.مَعَالِمَ الدِّينِ: the essential teachings and defining features of the religion
key_terms.وَصِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ: the designated successor of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith present Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as the rightful knowledgeable successor after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This narration recounts a Jewish descendant of Hārūn who questions Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام after ʿUmar directs him to him as the truly knowledgeable authority. The Imam answers his questions concerning sacred knowledge, the twelve just Imams, the مقام of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in Jannah, and the fate of the Prophet’s وصي, leading the questioner to embrace Islam and acknowledge Imam ʿAlī’s succession.
